After these things there was a cattle plague,
especially in the East,
for two years,
so that the lands lay fallow for lack of oxen.
And again there was a severe earthquake in Constantinople in the month of August,
and many houses, baths, and churches collapsed,
and the wall of the Golden Gate fell.
And the earthquake continued for forty days.
And in his twenty-seventh year,
Mundhir son of Nu'man, king of the Arabs, went up to the land of the Romans

and killed Mundhir in the territory of Qinnasrin.
And the son of Harith also died in the battle,
and he was buried in the martyrion there.
And in the thirty-first year of Justinian there was a severe earthquake,
and both of its walls, the inner and the outer, in Constantinople were cracked.
And the city of Rhegion was swallowed up by the earth,
so that its site could not be recognized.
